items.raw_excerpt: The Ministry of Finance may in future purchase health insurance from private insurers to cover civil servants, replacing the current system of paying medical expenses through the state budget, permanent secretary Lavaron Sangsnit said on Friday.
items.summary_en: Thailand's Ministry of Finance is looking at buying private health insurance for government workers. The new plan would replace the current system where the state pays medical bills directly. Permanent secretary Lavaron Sangsnit announced the potential change on Friday.
items.summary_ko: 태국 재무부가 공무원들의 건강보험을 민간 보험사에서 구매하는 방안을 검토 중입니다. 이번 변화는 정부가 의료비를 직접 지급하는 현재 시스템을 대체할 수 있습니다. 라브론 상스닛 차관보가 금요일에 이 가능성을 발표했습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: O levantamento detalha que os motociclistas de apps receberam, em média, R$ 2.221 mensais
items.summary_en: A survey finds app-based delivery motorcyclists in Brazil earn about R$2,221 per month on average. Only one in five of these riders has social security coverage. The findings highlight the precarity of gig work in the country.

items.raw_excerpt: El gobernador Salomón Jara no envía solo una iniciativa. Lleva la voz de los pueblos de Oaxaca. El senador Antonino Morales Toledo celebró la presentaciónSeguir leyendo
items.summary_en: Oaxaca Governor Salomón Jara is presenting a new constitution for the state. Senator Antonino Morales Toledo says it will be Mexico's first intercultural constitution. The document aims to reflect the voices of Oaxaca's indigenous peoples.

items.raw_excerpt: A botched racecourse that was longer than it should have been for the Edmonton Marathon has cost 13 runners a chance to compete in the prestigious Boston Marathon.
items.summary_en: A mistake made the Edmonton Marathon longer than it should be. Thirteen runners lost their chance to qualify for the Boston Marathon because of the extra distance. Organizers admitted the error and are working to make it right.

items.summary_en: Poland's oldest running electric train, a 63-year-old vehicle nicknamed Babcia or Granny, is back in service after a major overhaul. Built in 1963 at a Wrocław factory, it now runs weekend routes just northeast of Warsaw. The train got a new monitoring system, a modern toilet, and its classic yellow and blue paint.
